# Pinned Arena source data for generated numeric tests

These nine unmodified files come from IsaacLab-Arena revision8b4a3a47fc53de23e8205089d71109a2e2348acd. They are data for source-fingerprint and independent joint-order tests; The retained files are not imported as native modules. Generated tests also compile one hash-pinned helper and three selected AST assignment fragments as explicitly scoped native-formula oracles; they do not execute the full converter module, config constructor, Torch, or consumer. Product-supplied converter code is never executed. Original copyright/SPDX headers are retained. See UPSTREAM.json for exact paths, URLs, SHA256 and per-file license evidence. Eight files contain Apache-2.0 headers; modality.json has no inline header. No distinct inline notice or missing upstream repository-root LICENSE/NOTICE has been invented. The included standard Apache2.0 license text is copied from this project cached LICENSE-APACHE-2.0, not claimed as a fetched Arena root file.

All numeric trajectories in tests are explicitly generated. No original HDF5 arrays, cameras or converted Parquet data are included. The complete generated semantic tests run on any checkout with the ordinary dev dependencies; no private server paths or external acquisition are required.

Python source filenames use an inert .txt suffix to keep exact upstream code from being imported or linted as project implementation. Logical upstream names and unchanged content hashes are retained in UPSTREAM.json.

Reader03 additionally retains the exact 487-byte upstream `info.json` at `extra_info_template.json`; its logical source path and hash are in UPSTREAM.json. The ten upstream files remain inert test data.
